info.title: CED OPS API
info.description: RESTful API for the CED (Continuous Electro-Deposition) Operations management system. This API provides endpoints for managing quality inspections, chemical consumption tracking, daily startup and shutdown procedures, pre-delivery inspections, and operator performance analytics. It supports the full inspection lifecycle including creation, submission, approval workflows, and role-based access control.
